statement: Fresh C. briggsae will independently show within-token wildcard/literal-implementation state association with broad boundary context under the frozen occurrence-level test.

support_condition: If gate passes: p<=.01 strong; p<=.05 supported.

contamination_boundary: Frozen before C. briggsae sequence acquisition and before Drosophila sequence acquisition.
